title: 에어팟 끼면 괜찮아
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie ballad. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated pattern in 4/4 time. A soft, breathy male vocal performs a melodic, intimate lead. A subtle, warm electric bass enters with sustained root notes. Minimalist percussion consists of a soft, dampened kick drum on beats 1 and 3, with a light shaker or brush-like texture on the off-beats. The arrangement is sparse and acoustic-focused. Key of E Major. Tempo is 72 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar arpeggio]
(Hmm-mm-mm)

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
형광등이 얼굴을 깎는다 [soft kick drum enters]
거울 속 입술이 움직인다
내일 할 말을 고른다
한 문장이 세 번째 바뀌는 밤 [warm electric bass enters]
달바닥이 발끝을 씻긴다
수도꼭지에서 떨어지는
[acoustic guitar continues arpeggio]
물방울이 마침표를 찍는다
맨발이 타일 위를
